name: get_settings
description: Read the current Inner Breeze theme, appearance, scale and sidebar settings.

name: set_theme
description: Change and save the Inner Breeze color theme immediately.

name: set_theme_mode
description: Change and save light, dark or device-following mode.

name: set_setting
description: Change one app preference. Scale is in tenths (5 to 25), navigation is automatic/left/bottom/right/top (0 to 4), compact sidebar is 0 or 1, style is material/classic/lightfield (1 to 3).

name: open_view
description: Open an installed view or Settings in the same Inner Breeze app. Hidden Lumi remains available.

name: practice
description: Start an installed practice, or pause/resume the active session.

name: read_context
description: Read the current app state, available apps, tasks and habits.

name: add_todo
description: Add a task to the selected list.

name: complete_todo
description: Mark a task done using its exact ID.

name: reopen_todo
description: Reopen a completed task using its exact ID.

name: complete_habit
description: Complete a habit for today using its exact ID.

name: write_diary
description: Append the requested text to today's diary with the current time. Preserve the user's wording.

name: read_diary
description: Read the diary entry for a date when the user asks for it.

name: report_feedback
description: Save an app bug report or suggestion and queue it for the developer. Preserve the original report; exclude unrelated personal data. This reports feedback; it does not fix code.

name: show_progress_chart
description: Show a daily progress chart in Lumi from the active account's saved activity. Use only when requested. Includes today, fills missing days with zero, and keeps a snapshot in chat. sessions counts practices; meditation sums meditation seconds; retention shows each day's best WHM retention in seconds; habits counts scheduled habits that reached their completion target. Do not invent values or render a text imitation of the chart.

name: show_donation_links
description: Show Inner Breeze's official Bitcoin and Monero donation cards in Lumi when asked, with copy address, open wallet and Trocador browser actions. No payment or external navigation occurs until the user clicks. Use the returned official links; never invent a donation destination.

name: read_style
description: Read editable KSS, saved and live preview sources, shipped app/style-pack defaults, precedence and current revision for a scope. Always read before editing; preserve existing edits. Use supported KSS properties and existing component classes.

name: inspect_style
description: Inspect effective values and matching source rules for a widget/class/state in the selected scope. This reads the last valid preview without changing it.

name: preview_style
description: Replace the selected custom KSS draft and preview validated changes immediately. Invalid code remains editable and leaves the last working appearance intact. This does not save. Read the current revision first; send the complete custom sheet, preserving unrelated rules.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.

name: save_style
description: Validate and save the selected custom KSS draft for this account. Use after the user requests applying or keeping the preview.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.

name: reset_style
description: Reset the selected customization to its shipped default by saving an empty override. Other scopes and app data remain intact.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.

name: undo_style
description: Undo the latest edit in this scope and preview the restored draft. It is not saved until save_style.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.

name: discard_style
description: Discard unsaved changes in this scope and restore its saved appearance.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.

name: format_style
description: Format the current KSS draft without changing its meaning, then preview it. Saving is separate.

revision.description: The latest revision returned by read_style or the last successful style operation. Read again if another edit changed it.
